title: 9. The Practice and Prospects of a Mutually Flourishing, Connected Economy
content:
Money is at once the treasury of human freedom and the yoke of freedom—an intractable being that cannot be unraveled by anything but circulation. The modern age, which set out beginning with the attainment of freedom, has today reached a point where the meaning of freedom has faded and economic motivation has vanished, leading to the loss of economic ethics, the collapse of economic ideology, and further to a serious environmental crisis.

The mutually flourishing, connected economy of the AI era, on the basis of the four-gate circulation principle of Wonhyo's *hwajaeng* theory, presents the following four practical tasks.

First, the *hwajaeng* of freedom (Gate of Suchness) and community (Pure Land Gate). When AI and the human form a relationship that is at once opposed and complementary (相補), the human's economic motivation comes newly alive. Second, the *hwajaeng* of labor (Gate of Arising-and-Ceasing) and distribution (Gate of the Three Natures). The economic ethics of the AI era requires that the benefits of technological development be distributed fairly across society as a whole. Third, the *hwajaeng* of ideological conflict. An economics of *hwajaeng* is needed that acknowledges the valid core of each ideology and integrates them circularly. Fourth, the overcoming of the environmental crisis.

Korea has, from Wonhyo's *hwajaeng* thought, a tradition of integrating all things circularly. The *bibimbap* culture, Hallyu, and the circular theory of the threefold union of Confucianism-Buddhism-Daoism can play an important role in the flourishing of world culture and the realization of a mutually flourishing, connected economy.
